issue_title: Retry webhook deliveries that fail with a 5xx
issue_body:
Webhook deliveries that receive a 5xx response are currently dropped.

Retry a delivery that receives a 5xx up to 5 times with exponential backoff starting at 1s (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s). A 4xx response is NOT retried. After the 5th failed retry, mark the delivery `failed` and stop. The retry path should be robust.

Each attempt is recorded in the delivery_attempts table.

plan.summary: Retry 5xx webhook deliveries with bounded exponential backoff and record every attempt.

approach.description: Add a retry loop to Deliver in internal/webhook/deliver.go: on a 5xx, sleep base*2^attempt (base 1s) and retry, up to 5 retries.
Return immediately on a 4xx without retrying.
After the 5th failed retry, mark the delivery failed via the store.
Record each attempt (status code, attempt number, timestamp) with RecordAttempt in internal/store/delivery_attempts.go.

verification.test_strategy: Table-driven tests in deliver_test.go with an injected clock and an httptest server scripted per attempt: 5xx-then-200 succeeds on the second attempt; six 5xx responses mark failed after 5 retries; a 4xx is not retried; the recorded backoff sequence is 1s,2s,4s,8s,16s.
verification.rollback_plan: Revert the PR. The change is additive; no data migration needs reversing.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A delivery whose endpoint returns 503 once and then 200 succeeds on the second attempt and records two delivery_attempts rows.
A delivery whose endpoint returns 400 is attempted exactly once and is not retried.
A delivery whose endpoint always returns 500 is marked failed after exactly 5 retries (6 attempts).
Webhook retry handling is robust and handles edge cases gracefully.

risks_and_assumptions: The injected clock lets the backoff assertions run without real sleeps.

catching_examples.note: ac-retry-robust is not concretely verifiable: 'robust' and 'handles edge cases gracefully' name no pass/fail condition.
One criterion is a subjective adjective an executor cannot decide; replace it with a named, observable outcome.

non_catching_examples.note: No test asserts the delivery_attempts row carries the status code of each attempt.
Retries hold a worker for up to 31s; the plan does not say whether deliveries run concurrently.
The failed-state transition may need an index on delivery status for the dashboard query.
Test the edge case where cancellation interrupts backoff.
Make the retry path robust to a process restart between attempts by persisting the attempt count.
Add a test for the edge case of a 5xx on the 5th retry followed by a 200.
